cards.front: Complete the rule: Use right-of-way sensibly rather than insisting on…
cards.back: Use right-of-way sensibly rather than insisting on it; remain alert even when priority is yours.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At a four-way stop, every vehicle…
cards.back: At a four-way stop, every vehicle stops and the first arrival proceeds first.

cards.front: Complete the rule: If adjacent drivers reach a four-way stop at the…
cards.back: If adjacent drivers reach a four-way stop at the same time, yield to the driver on the right.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Entering a public road from a private drive or…
cards.back: Entering a public road from a private drive or road requires yielding to its vehicles and pedestrians without interfering with traffic.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A driver on an interstate entrance ramp…
cards.back: A driver on an interstate entrance ramp yields to traffic already on the highway.

cards.front: Complete the rule: When leaving a parked position…
cards.back: When leaving a parked position, wait for moving traffic to pass.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Never pass a vehicle stopped…
cards.back: Never pass a vehicle stopped for pedestrians in a crosswalk.

cards.front: Complete the rule: When vehicles reach an uncontrolled intersection at about the…
cards.back: When vehicles reach an uncontrolled intersection at about the same time, yield to the one on the right.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Yield to vehicles that…
cards.back: Yield to vehicles that have already entered an intersection.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A vehicle entering a traffic…
cards.back: A vehicle entering a traffic circle yields to vehicles already circulating.

cards.front: Complete the rule: For an emergency vehicle approaching from any direction with…
cards.back: For an emergency vehicle approaching from any direction with a siren and flashing light, move immediately to the road’s right side, clear of intersections, and stop until it passes.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Failing to yield as required to the described…
cards.back: Failing to yield as required to the described siren-and-flashing-light emergency vehicle is a Class E crime.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A left-turning motorist yields to an oncoming cyclist or…
cards.back: A left-turning motorist yields to an oncoming cyclist or roller skier and turns only when safe without interfering with them.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Yield to pedestrians in a marked crosswalk when…
cards.back: Yield to pedestrians in a marked crosswalk when no traffic signal or police officer controls the intersection.

cards.front: Complete the rule: While turning, yield to…
cards.back: While turning, yield to pedestrians crossing with the signal.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before crossing a sidewalk from an alley or…
cards.back: Before crossing a sidewalk from an alley or driveway, stop and wait for pedestrians and traffic.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Always yield to schoolchildren…
cards.back: Always yield to schoolchildren who are crossing the street.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Traffic controls include signals, signs, markings and directions…
cards.back: Traffic controls include signals, signs, markings and directions from police, highway workers or school crossing guards.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not drive through a parking…
cards.back: Do not drive through a parking area to evade a traffic-control requirement.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A vertical traffic signal places red above yellow above…
cards.back: A vertical traffic signal places red above yellow above green; a horizontal signal places red left, yellow middle and green right.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A green light permits proceeding cautiously only when…
cards.back: A green light permits proceeding cautiously only when the route is clear of vehicles and pedestrians.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A yellow signal warns of an approaching red…
cards.back: A yellow signal warns of an approaching red phase and calls for slowing as the intersection clears.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At red, stop before entering the intersection and remain…
cards.back: At red, stop before entering the intersection and remain behind the stop line or crosswalk until permitted to proceed.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A right turn on red is allowed after a…
cards.back: A right turn on red is allowed after a stop unless signs prohibit it, and the turning driver must yield to pedestrians and all vehicle traffic.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At a flashing yellow light, slow down, proceed…
cards.back: At a flashing yellow light, slow down, proceed cautiously and be ready to stop for traffic.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A flashing red traffic light requires…
cards.back: A flashing red traffic light requires stopping and checking both directions before entering.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At a railway crossing with flashing red lights and…
cards.back: At a railway crossing with flashing red lights and barriers, wait until the flashing stops and the barriers rise before proceeding.

cards.front: Complete the rule: With a red light and a green arrow, move…
cards.back: With a red light and a green arrow, move cautiously only in the arrow’s direction while yielding to other vehicles and pedestrians.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A steady yellow arrow…
cards.back: A steady yellow arrow clears turning traffic before red.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A steady upward green…
cards.back: A steady upward green arrow permits straight-ahead movement.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A steady red turn arrow requires the indicated…
cards.back: A steady red turn arrow requires the indicated turning traffic to wait until the arrow becomes green.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Where multiple traffic lights are present…
cards.back: Where multiple traffic lights are present, follow the light directly above your lane.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A steady red overhead X…
cards.back: A steady red overhead X closes that lane to driving.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A steady yellow overhead X means leave the…
cards.back: A steady yellow overhead X means leave the lane because its signal is about to become red.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A flashing yellow overhead X permits…
cards.back: A flashing yellow overhead X permits that lane only for a left turn.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A green overhead arrow identifies…
cards.back: A green overhead arrow identifies a lane available for use.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Warning signs are generally yellow diamonds with black…
cards.back: Warning signs are generally yellow diamonds with black text or symbols that warn of hazards ahead.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A black cross on a yellow…
cards.back: A black cross on a yellow diamond warns of an intersection ahead.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A main vertical stroke with a side branch…
cards.back: A main vertical stroke with a side branch on a yellow diamond warns of a side road.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A black T on a…
cards.back: A black T on a yellow diamond warns of a T-intersection.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The yellow No Passing Zone…
cards.back: The yellow No Passing Zone pennant identifies a no-passing area.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A winding black arrow on a yellow…
cards.back: A winding black arrow on a yellow diamond warns of a curving road ahead.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A black right-curving arrow on a…
cards.back: A black right-curving arrow on a yellow diamond warns of a right curve.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The divided-highway-begins warning shows opposing…
cards.back: The divided-highway-begins warning shows opposing arrows separating around a divider.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The divided-highway-ends warning shows opposing…
cards.back: The divided-highway-ends warning shows opposing traffic beside a divider ending ahead.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The lane-ends warning depicts one…
cards.back: The lane-ends warning depicts one lane boundary tapering toward the other.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A diagonal branch joining an…
cards.back: A diagonal branch joining an upward arrow warns of merging traffic.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Two upward arrows separated by a…
cards.back: Two upward arrows separated by a dashed divider identify the illustrated added-lane warning.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A traffic-signal picture on a yellow diamond…
cards.back: A traffic-signal picture on a yellow diamond warns that a traffic light is ahead.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A stop-sign symbol beneath an upward arrow…
cards.back: A stop-sign symbol beneath an upward arrow warns that a stop sign is ahead.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The illustrated black chevron on…
cards.back: The illustrated black chevron on yellow warns of a sharp curve.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A curve warning paired with an advisory-speed…
cards.back: A curve warning paired with an advisory-speed plaque gives a suggested speed around that curve.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The illustrated yellow school-zone…
cards.back: The illustrated yellow school-zone pentagon contains two walking figures.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The pedestrian-crossing warning shows a…
cards.back: The pedestrian-crossing warning shows a walking person on a yellow diamond.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The Share the Road warning combines a…
cards.back: The Share the Road warning combines a bicycle, car and wording about sharing with bicycles.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A bicycle pictured alone on a…
cards.back: A bicycle pictured alone on a yellow diamond warns of a bicycle crossing.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A car above wavy skid marks warns…
cards.back: A car above wavy skid marks warns of a road that is slippery when wet.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A round yellow railroad warning with a black X…
cards.back: A round yellow railroad warning with a black X and RR calls for slowing, looking, listening and readiness to stop.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A white railroad crossbuck marks a crossing where an…
cards.back: A white railroad crossbuck marks a crossing where an approaching train requires stopping behind the line or before the tracks.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Look for additional tracks and trains…
cards.back: Look for additional tracks and trains even when no track-count sign is posted.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Look both ways and cross railroad…
cards.back: Look both ways and cross railroad tracks promptly without stopping on them.

cards.front: Complete the rule: After a train crosses, wait until it is well…
cards.back: After a train crosses, wait until it is well down the track and any gates or lights indicate it is safe.

cards.front: Complete the rule: When traffic or a signal requires a stop near…
cards.back: When traffic or a signal requires a stop near tracks, wait at the stop line before the tracks.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Work-zone warnings are orange diamonds or…
cards.back: Work-zone warnings are orange diamonds or rectangles with black words or symbols.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The illustrated work-zone warnings identify flaggers, workers…
cards.back: The illustrated work-zone warnings identify flaggers, workers, construction, a one-lane road and a detour.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Follow a…
cards.back: Follow a work-zone flagger’s directions.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At a temporary traffic signal, stop at…
cards.back: At a temporary traffic signal, stop at its white line if one is present.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Barrels, cones, tubes and barriers identify restricted work…
cards.back: Barrels, cones, tubes and barriers identify restricted work areas, and a Road Closed barrier prevents entry.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Slow down in work zones, avoid…
cards.back: Slow down in work zones, avoid tailgating and be ready to stop promptly.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A speeding fine in…
cards.back: A speeding fine in a work zone is doubled.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Regulatory signs give enforceable directions about matters…
cards.back: Regulatory signs give enforceable directions about matters such as speed, turns, lanes and parking.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A red circle crossed by a…
cards.back: A red circle crossed by a red diagonal bar prohibits the pictured action.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A crossed-out left-turn arrow…
cards.back: A crossed-out left-turn arrow prohibits a left turn.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A crossed-out right-turn arrow…
cards.back: A crossed-out right-turn arrow prohibits a right turn.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A crossed-out U-shaped…
cards.back: A crossed-out U-shaped arrow prohibits a U-turn.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A single upward regulatory…
cards.back: A single upward regulatory arrow directs straight travel.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The left-turn-only sign directs…
cards.back: The left-turn-only sign directs traffic to turn left.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A combined upward-and-right arrow permits…
cards.back: A combined upward-and-right arrow permits straight travel or a right turn.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A black-and-white speed-limit sign states…
cards.back: A black-and-white speed-limit sign states the legal speed for ideal conditions.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A stop sign is a…
cards.back: A stop sign is a red octagon with white lettering.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At a stop sign, stop behind…
cards.back: At a stop sign, stop behind an available stop line or crosswalk.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Without a stop line or crosswalk, stop near enough…
cards.back: Without a stop line or crosswalk, stop near enough to see cross traffic but before any part of the vehicle enters the intersection.

cards.front: Complete the rule: After stopping, proceed only when safe and…
cards.back: After stopping, proceed only when safe and yield to any vehicles or pedestrians present.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A modern yield sign is a downward-pointing red-and-white…
cards.back: A modern yield sign is a downward-pointing red-and-white triangle; older examples may be yellow with black letters.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At a yield sign, slow and allow traffic or…
cards.back: At a yield sign, slow and allow traffic or pedestrians with priority to clear before entering or crossing.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A shared center left-turn lane serves left turns…
cards.back: A shared center left-turn lane serves left turns from either direction, not through travel or passing.

cards.front: Complete the rule: On a one-way street, travel only in the…
cards.back: On a one-way street, travel only in the arrow’s direction and do not turn against it.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Obey police directions…
cards.back: Obey police directions controlling vehicles or pedestrians.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Refusing or failing to follow police traffic orders is…
cards.back: Refusing or failing to follow police traffic orders is illegal, and attempting to flee can cost a license.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Traffic signs and signals carry legal authority…
cards.back: Traffic signs and signals carry legal authority when no police officer is directing traffic.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Removing or defacing…
cards.back: Removing or defacing traffic signs is unlawful.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Guide signs are generally green, brown or blue squares…
cards.back: Guide signs are generally green, brown or blue squares or rectangles used for destinations, roads, points of interest and services.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Route-marker shape and color identify the roadway…
cards.back: Route-marker shape and color identify the roadway type, including Interstate, U.S. and state routes.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The illustrated Interstate route marker is a…
cards.back: The illustrated Interstate route marker is a blue shield topped with a red Interstate band.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The illustrated U.S. route marker is…
cards.back: The illustrated U.S. route marker is a white shield with black route numerals.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The illustrated state-route marker uses a…
cards.back: The illustrated state-route marker uses a white circular area inside a black square.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Plan a route with a map or GPS and…
cards.back: Plan a route with a map or GPS and follow route markers while traveling in an unfamiliar area.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Pavement markings divide lanes, indicate passing or lane…
cards.back: Pavement markings divide lanes, indicate passing or lane changes, identify turns and crosswalks, and mark stopping places.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A broken yellow center line marks…
cards.back: A broken yellow center line marks opposite-direction traffic where the marking permits passing.

cards.front: Complete the rule: With a solid-and-broken yellow center pair…
cards.back: With a solid-and-broken yellow center pair, passing is permitted from the broken-line side.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A double solid yellow center…
cards.back: A double solid yellow center pair prohibits passing in both directions.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A broken white lane divider separates lanes traveling…
cards.back: A broken white lane divider separates lanes traveling in the same direction in the illustrated passing-permitted example.

cards.front: Complete the rule: For ordinary through driving, prefer the lane with…
cards.back: For ordinary through driving, prefer the lane with the smoothest flow and least repeated stopping and starting.

cards.front: Complete the rule: With at least three lanes in one direction…
cards.back: With at least three lanes in one direction, a middle lane usually has the smoothest traffic flow.

cards.front: Complete the rule: On a multilane road, the left lane serves passing…
cards.back: On a multilane road, the left lane serves passing or left turns, while the right serves slower traffic and entering or exiting vehicles.

cards.front: Complete the rule: With two lanes in one direction, the…
cards.back: With two lanes in one direction, the right lane generally has the smoother flow.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Passing is generally…
cards.back: Passing is generally done on the left.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not pass by leaving the pavement…
cards.back: Do not pass by leaving the pavement or main traveled part of the roadway.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not use a signed…
cards.back: Do not use a signed turning-only center lane for passing.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Passing on the right is permitted when the other…
cards.back: Passing on the right is permitted when the other vehicle is turning left and there is room for at least two same-direction lanes.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Passing on the right is also permitted when the…
cards.back: Passing on the right is also permitted when the other car occupies the left lane of a road with at least two marked same-direction lanes.

cards.front: Complete the rule: On three-lane sections in either direction of the Maine…
cards.back: On three-lane sections in either direction of the Maine Turnpike or Interstate ninety-five, trucks other than pickups must use the two rightmost lanes.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Approach a left turn in the lane nearest the…
cards.back: Approach a left turn in the lane nearest the center line and wait near the intersection midpoint with the wheels straight until it is clear.

cards.front: Complete the rule: For a right turn, start in the rightmost lane…
cards.back: For a right turn, start in the rightmost lane and stay as close to the curb as possible throughout the turn.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Complete a left turn into the leftmost lane traveling…
cards.back: Complete a left turn into the leftmost lane traveling in the new direction, whether the receiving road is divided, one-way or two-way.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Complete a right turn into the…
cards.back: Complete a right turn into the rightmost lane traveling in the new direction.

cards.front: Complete the rule: For a left turn from a one-way street…
cards.back: For a left turn from a one-way street, position near the left curb or roadway edge.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Change to another lane only after finishing…
cards.back: Change to another lane only after finishing the turn and when traffic is clear.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Keep the wheels straight while waiting to turn so…
cards.back: Keep the wheels straight while waiting to turn so a rear impact does not push the vehicle into oncoming traffic.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Once committed through an intersection or into a turn…
cards.back: Once committed through an intersection or into a turn, continue the maneuver rather than making a last-second change; correct a route mistake at the next intersection.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The illustrated two-lane-use sign requires a left turn from…
cards.back: The illustrated two-lane-use sign requires a left turn from the left lane while the right lane may go straight or turn right.

cards.front: Complete the rule: The illustrated three-lane-use signs permit left or straight from…
cards.back: The illustrated three-lane-use signs permit left or straight from the left lane, straight only from the center and a right turn only from the right.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A solid white divider separates same-direction lanes…
cards.back: A solid white divider separates same-direction lanes with different uses and discourages changing between them.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Broken white dividers identify same-direction…
cards.back: Broken white dividers identify same-direction lanes and allow safe lane changes.

cards.front: Complete the rule: At a stop sign or signal, stop before the…
cards.back: At a stop sign or signal, stop before the stop line or crosswalk; if a stop line precedes the crosswalk, use that line.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Where no crosswalk is marked, stop before…
cards.back: Where no crosswalk is marked, stop before the intersection near enough to see approaching traffic.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Crosswalks can be at intersections or midblock and…
cards.back: Crosswalks can be at intersections or midblock and are often indicated by yellow or white markings.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Stop when a school crossing guard directs you, and…
cards.back: Stop when a school crossing guard directs you, and yield to schoolchildren crossing in rural areas as well as towns.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Stop before a painted stop line so…
cards.back: Stop before a painted stop line so pedestrians have space ahead of the vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the rule: While turning, yield to pedestrians in either marked…
cards.back: While turning, yield to pedestrians in either marked or unmarked crosswalks even when your signal is green.

cards.front: Complete the rule: For a roadway pedestrian using a white cane or…
cards.back: For a roadway pedestrian using a white cane or guide dog, halt at least ten feet away and remain stopped until the person is no longer in danger.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Failure to yield to a visually impaired pedestrian is…
cards.back: Failure to yield to a visually impaired pedestrian is a traffic infraction with a fine from fifty dollars to one thousand dollars.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before entering a shared left-turn lane, check mirrors and…
cards.back: Before entering a shared left-turn lane, check mirrors and traffic ahead, signal left and check the left blind spot; turn when clear.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A shared center left-turn lane is illustrated…
cards.back: A shared center left-turn lane is illustrated with solid-and-broken yellow borders and opposing left-turn arrows.

cards.front: Complete the rule: A reversible lane carries traffic in different directions at…
cards.back: A reversible lane carries traffic in different directions at different times, so check its current overhead signal before entry.

cards.front: Complete the rule: Reversible lanes may have double broken yellow borders; a…
cards.back: Reversible lanes may have double broken yellow borders; a green arrow allows use and a red X closes the lane.
